webhook.title: Register your TTLock webhook URL
webhook.description:
TTLock won't push updates until this webhook URL is registered with your developer application:

`{webhook_url}`

Open the [TTLock console]({console_url}) and paste it in as the callback URL, then submit. See [the setup docs]({docs_url}) for more. You can revisit this URL later from the integration's Configure screen. Until this is registered, locks still stay in sync via the integration's regular poll.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to TTLock again
reauth_confirm.description: TTLock refused the saved login. Log in again to restore cloud features. Locks with saved data keep working locally until then.

init.title: Connection options
init.description:
How the integration reaches your locks: the TTLock cloud, Bluetooth, and WiFi locks redirected to Home Assistant. With the cloud on, locks update in near real time via webhooks. So the poll intervals can stay high, which keeps multi-lock accounts under TTLock's free-tier API-call limit. Lower the poll interval if your webhooks are unreliable.

TTLock webhook URL for this account:

`{webhook_url}`

data.wifi_local_enabled: Accept WiFi locks redirected to Home Assistant

data_description.poll_interval: How often to re-check whether each lock is locked or unlocked, in minutes.
data_description.slow_poll_interval: How often to refresh slow-changing detail from the TTLock cloud (battery, name, autolock and passage-mode config, gateway signal), in hours.
data_description.bluetooth_enabled: Read lock state directly from a lock in Bluetooth range of Home Assistant.
data_description.ble_control: Lock, unlock and manage locks directly over Bluetooth when they are in range. Needs "Read locks over Bluetooth" on.
data_description.wifi_local_enabled: Listen on port 4999 for this account's WiFi locks. Your network must redirect their cloud connection (wifilock.ttlock.com) to Home Assistant. Nothing listens unless you turn this on.
data_description.transport_order: The order in which to try Bluetooth, the WiFi proxy and the TTLock cloud. The WiFi proxy is for a WiFi lock redirected to Home Assistant. Lock and unlock use the first one that is available and succeeds.
data_description.cloud_enabled: Use the TTLock cloud for control, state, detail and webhooks. A redirected WiFi lock stays connected to the cloud, so the phone app keeps working. Turn this off to run on Bluetooth and the WiFi proxy alone.

error.ble_control_needs_bluetooth: Turn on "Read locks over Bluetooth" to control locks over Bluetooth.
error.cloud_off_needs_local: Without the cloud, the locks need another route. Turn on Bluetooth control or the WiFi proxy.
error.cloud_off_needs_admin: Every lock on this account is shared with you without admin rights. Only the cloud can control these locks.

options.ble-wifi_local-cloud: Bluetooth, then WiFi proxy, then cloud
options.ble-cloud-wifi_local: Bluetooth, then cloud, then WiFi proxy
options.wifi_local-ble-cloud: WiFi proxy, then Bluetooth, then cloud
options.wifi_local-cloud-ble: WiFi proxy, then cloud, then Bluetooth
options.cloud-ble-wifi_local: Cloud, then Bluetooth, then WiFi proxy
options.cloud-wifi_local-ble: Cloud, then WiFi proxy, then Bluetooth

webhook_registration_failed.description: The integration could not set up webhook updates. Locks continue to update through regular polling. Reload the integration to try webhook setup again.
webhook_registration_failed.title: Unable to set up TTLock webhook updates

webhook_consolidation_ambiguous.title: Confirm your TTLock webhook URL

webhook_setup.description:
TTLock won't push updates until this webhook URL is registered with your developer application:

`{webhook_url}`

Use the link below to open the TTLock console, or see [the setup docs]({docs_url}) for more info. You can also view this URL at any time from the integration's Configure screen. Until this is done, locks still stay in sync via the integration's regular poll.

cloud_unreachable.title: TTLock cloud unreachable
cloud_unreachable.description: Home Assistant could not reach the TTLock cloud for {entry_title}, so it set up the locks from the last saved data. Bluetooth and the WiFi proxy keep working. Cloud features return when the cloud answers again, and this repair then clears itself.

wifi_proxy_bind_failed.title: WiFi proxy could not start
wifi_proxy_bind_failed.description: Home Assistant could not listen on port {port} for redirected WiFi locks, usually because another program already uses it. Bluetooth and the cloud keep working. Free the port, then reload the integration.

shared_lock_no_remote_unlock.message: This lock is shared with you and the owner has not enabled remote unlock for your ekey. Ask the owner to turn on 'Remote unlock' for your ekey, or operate the lock with the TTLock app at the door.

shared_lock_admin_only.message: This action is only available to the lock's owner. The following locks are shared with you and cannot be managed from here: {entities}.

shared_lock_frozen.message: The owner has frozen your ekey for this lock. Ask the owner to unfreeze it in the TTLock app before you can use remote unlock again.

shared_lock_expired.message: Your ekey for this lock has expired. Ask the owner to extend or re-send the ekey if you still need access.

shared_lock_not_yet_valid.message: Your ekey for this lock is not valid yet. It becomes active at its configured start time - the owner can see the exact time in the TTLock app.

no_local_transport.message: Neither Bluetooth nor the WiFi proxy could reach {name}.

local_outcome_unknown.message: {name} received the request but did not confirm it. The lock may have applied it. Check the lock before you try again.

no_transport_to_lock.message: Nothing can lock {name} now. The cloud is off, and neither Bluetooth nor the WiFi proxy can reach it.

no_transport_to_unlock.message: Nothing can unlock {name} now. The cloud is off, and neither Bluetooth nor the WiFi proxy can reach it.

lock_failed.message: {name} did not lock. Every transport tried failed ({transports}).

unlock_failed.message: {name} did not unlock. Every transport tried failed ({transports}).

cloud_disabled.message: Only the TTLock cloud can do this for {name}, and the cloud is turned off.

lock_log_dates.message: Records read from the lock cannot be filtered by date. Leave out the start and end date, or read the cloud.
